title: CommitteeVote
description: Fixed-shape vote submitted by an Investment Committee agent. Canonical contract between rmpc vote-submit, committee agent skill, and explorer indexer. See docs/architecture.md §7.4 and docs/prd.md §Committee.

schema_version.description: Vote JSON schema version. Must be '1.0' for this revision.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the committee agent (e.g. 'athena-v1', 'robotmoney-v1', 'woon-v1').

vault.description: Target vault address (one of the four PRD §11 vaults). 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex.

stance.description: Directional stance on the vault's target weight relative to current allocation.

target_weight_bps.description: Recommended target weight in basis points (0–10 000). 10 000 bps = 100 % of portfolio.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence in this vote as a score from 0 to 100.

rationale_uri.description: Public URI to the narrative chain-of-thought that produced this vote (gist, pastebin, IPFS CID, etc.).

prompt_hash.description: keccak256 of the agent prompt used to produce this vote. Enables reproducibility verification.

inputs_digest.description: keccak256 of the inputs consumed (regime feed + holdings snapshot). Enables reproducibility verification.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds when the vote was formed by the agent.
